            }
        }
    }
	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }

	show_disabled = yes
	
	can_construct = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }

	cost_gold = resource_district_normal_tier_1_cost
	province_government_modifier = {
		not_parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_artisan_tax = rice_confectionary_income_tier_1
	}
	province_government_modifier = {
		parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_artisan_tax = rice_confectionary_income_tier_1_tribal
	}

	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_sugar
		amount = basic_resource_need
		modifiers = {
			province_government_modifier = {
				not_parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = confectionary_artisan_income_per_sugar_need
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = confectionary_artisan_income_per_sugar_need_tribal
			}
		}
	}

	on_complete = {

	}

	next_building = confectionary_2
	type_icon = "resource_buildings/sugar_buildings.dds"
	
	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_resource_building_consumer_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_sugar }
		directive_to_build_economy_modifier = yes
		ai_income_building_modifier = yes
		ai_resource_new_building_modifier = yes
	}
}
